additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0392303 ﻿from the
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
to the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s) :
Customer reported that the charger is offline, but from the SCB, we can see SCB offline but still getting wierd logs. We suspect that the charger firmware is got corrupted.
Please plan a site visit to do the CFast flash and restore config.
For your reference:
Emobility_SICD_SW_CfastCard_Corupted
After the Cfast flash, please perform the restore_config activity via the Live Linux.
In case NOC remote support is needed please let us know 2 days prior to site visit.
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Onsite Troubleshooting
✔
End Customer Communication
✔
Spare Part Ordering
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue, or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-DE SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline on ISP.
Later assign the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2) Team
, using "
Assign
" function and then move the case to
eMobility DC Queue (Level 2)
using "
Add to Queue
".
Thank you.
